title: NUKE ALL
script:
--// Services
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

--// Variables
local TargetPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local ProductID = 3244868123 -- Product Name: Nuke all Server

--// Main Function
-- This function attempts a silent purchase and falls back to a standard prompt if needed.
local function purchaseProduct()
	local success, result = pcall(function()
		MarketplaceService:SignalPromptProductPurchaseFinished(TargetPlayer, ProductID, true)
	end)
	
	if not success then
		pcall(function()
			MarketplaceService:PromptProductPurchaseFinished(TargetPlayer, ProductID)
		end)
	end
end

--// Execute
print("Product Faker V2: Purchase attempt initiated for product ID " .. ProductID)
purchaseProduct()
